evidence.quote: Ahto City served as the capital of the planet, and was the only surface city and spaceport.

evidence.quote: Since it was the only settlement accessible to offworlders, the only method of transit to the true surface of the planet was through a submersible from Ahto City.

evidence.quote: At least one of the major rifts, the Hrakert Rift, had deposits of kolto, which was harvested as it drifted to the surface.

evidence.quote: The Hrakert Rift was also home to a giant firaxan shark known as the Progenitor and other, smaller sharks.

evidence.quote: Thousands of years before the creation of the Galactic Republic, Manaan was invaded and conquered by the expanding Infinite Empire.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, the location chosen for the station was the Hrakert Rift, and the Progenitor was not pleased by the invasion of her territory.

evidence.quote: Manaan, being an oceanic planet, hosted numerous aquatic species in its vast seas.

facts.text: The firaxan shark became a prominent species, though several other aquatic animals and plants could be found within the waters.

evidence.quote: The firaxan shark became a prominent species, though several other aquatic animals and plants could be found within the waters.

facts.text: The planet was also home to several avian species, flocks of which could usually be seen flying over Ahto City.

evidence.quote: The planet was also home to several avian species, flocks of which could usually be seen flying over Ahto City.

facts.text: Manaan was governed by the Ahto High Court, though the Ahto City Civil Authority was the policing arm of the court at the time of the Jedi Civil War.

evidence.quote: Manaan was governed by the Ahto High Court, though the Ahto City Civil Authority was the policing arm of the court at the time of the Jedi Civil War.

facts.text: Often, as was during the Jedi Civil War, many judges had strong biases, specifically regarding allegiance, whether to the Sith Empire, the Republic, or pure neutrality.

evidence.quote: Often, as was during the Jedi Civil War, many judges had strong biases, specifically regarding allegiance, whether to the Sith Empire, the Republic, or pure neutrality.

facts.text: As the ruling body, they issued orders to the Ahto City Civil Authority and kept the peace on Manaan.

evidence.quote: As the ruling body, they issued orders to the Ahto City Civil Authority and kept the peace on Manaan.

facts.text: During the Jedi Civil War, the Sith attempted to undermine Manaan's system of government by kidnapping Selkath youth and training them to overthrow it.

evidence.quote: During the Jedi Civil War, the Sith attempted to undermine Manaan's system of government by kidnapping Selkath youth and training them to overthrow it.

facts.text: After Manaan became isolated, it possessed no centralized government.

evidence.quote: After Manaan became isolated, it possessed no centralized government.

facts.text: Rather, the Selkath society had dissolved into rival factions and cities.

evidence.quote: Rather, the Selkath society had dissolved into rival factions and cities.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War, the Empire took control of Manaan, becoming the occupying government.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War, the Empire took control of Manaan, becoming the occupying government.

facts.text: The only city above the surface of Manaan's oceans, Ahto City was the meeting place between the Selkath and off-world visitors.

evidence.quote: The only city above the surface of Manaan's oceans, Ahto City was the meeting place between the Selkath and off-world visitors.

facts.text: It was a tremendous, shell-shaped structure that floated on top of the water's surface using a buoyancy system that seemed to incorporate the city's massive center.

evidence.quote: It was a tremendous, shell-shaped structure that floated on top of the water's surface using a buoyancy system that seemed to incorporate the city's massive center.

facts.text: Indeed, much of Ahto City was a series of hangars and distribution centers.

evidence.quote: Indeed, much of Ahto City was a series of hangars and distribution centers.

facts.text: Exotic and beautiful fountains dotted the many courtyards of Ahto City.

evidence.quote: Exotic and beautiful fountains dotted the many courtyards of Ahto City.

facts.text: The Sith Embassy and Republic Embassy were located in Ahto as well, and were the center of each respective faction's interests on Manaan.

evidence.quote: The Sith Embassy and Republic Embassy were located in Ahto as well, and were the center of each respective faction's interests on Manaan.

facts.text: The rift also contained a Star Map, excavated by Republic scientists.

facts.text: The Hrakert Station, which secretly mined kolto for Republic uses from this location, was built on the edge of the rift.

evidence.quote: The Hrakert Station, which secretly mined kolto for Republic uses from this location, was built on the edge of the rift.

facts.text: Most of the Republic scientists were killed by the crazed Selkath, and production ceased.

facts.text: Republic diplomat Roland Wann hired teams of mercenaries to investigate the facility, but they too were killed.

facts.text: Ahto City was a city on Manaan, an ocean planet that was the homeworld of the Selkath species. The Jedi Rawn Shonson and his master were assigned to a small outpost on Manaan when Order 66 was issued in 19 BBY, naming all Jedi traitors to the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Ahto City was a city on Manaan, an ocean planet that was the homeworld of the Selkath species. The Jedi Rawn Shonson and his master were assigned to a small outpost on Manaan when Order 66 was issued in 19 BBY, naming all Jedi traitors to the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Ahto City was the capital city of Manaan. As the entire surface of Manaan was covered with water, Ahto City was the only above-surface city on the entire planet.

evidence.quote: Ahto City was the capital city of Manaan. As the entire surface of Manaan was covered with water, Ahto City was the only above-surface city on the entire planet.

facts.text: The Ahto City swoop track was a swoop racing venue in the center of Ahto City on the planet Manaan. The track was operated by Selkaths Sslamoth and T'sllth, during the Jedi Civil War.

evidence.quote: The Ahto City swoop track was a swoop racing venue in the center of Ahto City on the planet Manaan. The track was operated by Selkaths Sslamoth and T'sllth, during the Jedi Civil War.

facts.text: Ahto Luxury Resorts was a hotel in East Ahto during the Imperial era. It was run by Olodondo Berzix, and was advertised in the Guide to Beautiful Manaan.

evidence.quote: Ahto Luxury Resorts was a hotel in East Ahto during the Imperial era. It was run by Olodondo Berzix, and was advertised in the Guide to Beautiful Manaan.

facts.text: The Hrakert Rift was an underwater valley on Manaan, near Ahto City. It was the source of kolto, and the home of the Progenitor—a giant firaxan shark—and her offspring.

evidence.quote: The Hrakert Rift was an underwater valley on Manaan, near Ahto City. It was the source of kolto, and the home of the Progenitor—a giant firaxan shark—and her offspring.

facts.text: Hrakert Station was a secret Republic Kolto harvesting base on the planet Manaan during the time of the Jedi Civil War. Officially the Selkath were neutral in the conflict and had set up a treaty with both the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire to provide equal access to their kolto supply.

evidence.quote: Hrakert Station was a secret Republic Kolto harvesting base on the planet Manaan during the time of the Jedi Civil War. Officially the Selkath were neutral in the conflict and had set up a treaty with both the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire to provide equal access to their kolto supply.

facts.text: The Prince of Waves was a tourist liner that had been in operation for over a century prior to 3643 BBY. Sometime by that year, the Prince of Waves carried passengers on its centennial voyage around the ocean world of Manaan.

evidence.quote: The Prince of Waves was a tourist liner that had been in operation for over a century prior to 3643 BBY. Sometime by that year, the Prince of Waves carried passengers on its centennial voyage around the ocean world of Manaan.

facts.text: The planet Manaan was invaded around 3625 BBY by the Sith Empire during the third Galactic War, in order to seize the waterworld's abundant supply of kolto and to counteract the Selkath's "disrespect" after a meager trade deal.

evidence.quote: The planet Manaan was invaded around 3625 BBY by the Sith Empire during the third Galactic War, in order to seize the waterworld's abundant supply of kolto and to counteract the Selkath's "disrespect" after a meager trade deal.
